verdict.rationale: Otter AI Chat is a built-in assistant that can be delegated tasks: answering questions across meetings, drafting follow-ups/reports, extracting action items, and querying connected CRMs — all described in first-party docs (otter-docs-1, otter-docs-8, otter-docs-11, otter-docs-41). This matches the story of an in-product AI assistant handling delegated tasks. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the AI Chat assistant's task-delegation quality (community evidence only covers transcription/privacy issues, not AI Chat itself), and no detail on how autonomous/agentic the assistant's task execution actually is beyond Q&A and content drafting.
